<!-- pr-reviewer: f4952ab5c7194ec6e74dc096af9ddca4610a33b7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The test meets #1853. It checks the levels on both sides of the band edge and the clearance link across that edge. It also checks move continuity, the verification result, and zero gouge cells. The decision record explains the small fixture.

Local results against upstream/main 31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239:
- Trial merge: clean; main is already an ancestor of this head.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 1 step, 0 failed. The changed suite had 2 passed, 0 failed, and 6 ignored tests (7.04 s).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

All checks ran locally in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used. The six heavy tests did not run.

This PR changes tests and a decision record only. It changes no production G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. The author's two mutation checks were read, but were not run again. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
